description.value: Horsethief Creek Pub & Eatery is a full-service pub and restaurant in Radium Hot Springs, sitting near the eastern entrance to Kootenay National Park and the Sinclair Canyon — a natural stop for cyclists on the Columbia Valley corridor. The pub's name comes from a local legend about a horse thief who hid along a nearby creek while fleeing through the canyon, a tale told in full on the website. The kitchen runs a broad menu of house-made burgers, roasted meats, and pub classics, with live music on Sundays and karaoke nights rounding out the experience.
